title: Doug W NDE 4203
content: I found myself totally lucid, clear in mind and thought, floating in blackness. It felt as if I was lying on my side, but without feeling any pressure on the side I was lying on. To get a point of reference I looked down at myself, and observed I was all in white. My skin was a translucent white. I was wearing an oversized robe. Thinking of my position it shifted on its own, and now I felt I was upright, and I started to look around. The darkness had depth; it felt like the void went on to infinity. I was comfortable, and realized something had happened during the surgery, and I must had died. I got excited, because I was happy that my passing was painless. I was getting anxious to move on, and was wondering, and talking to myself when someone was coming to get me. I waited, and waited, time seemed to come to a standstill. I began to call out, if anyone was out there. No response, and became angry, and feeling abandoned, and cursed. Next thing I see is a room with people running all around me doing different things to my body. I realized I was back in the hospital, back in the awareness of my body still no pain, and I wasn't breathing. This went on for at least five minutes, and I was amazed that no one noticed I was awake and looking around. I realized later that I might have been looking through my eyelids. Anyway, they began to roll my body on its back, and started to put tubes down my throat, and this is when I lost consciousness again. I later woke up on a respirator, stuck on that for a week or more, and developed a fever. Until about a month later, my mind started to work overtime, on the NDE. I wanted to do more exploring in that state again. Re-experience it, and move beyond that experience. I also had many unanswered questions. Why did I end up in a void? If there is a hell, is that where I was destined for? If so, why? Why didn't anyone come get me or see me? I think for the first time I found a real passion to pursue. It took ten years before the answers started to be revealed to me through Out Of Body experiences I started to have. The journey still continues.

environment.environment_other_detail: Blackness/void with depth that felt infinite.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Sudden shift from the void to seeing the hospital room and staff working on his body; later lost consciousness again during intubation.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Void/darkness; later visual awareness of hospital staff working on his body; no tunnel/light/beings/life review/boundary described.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/void first; then abrupt perception of hospital room and resuscitation/intubation; then loss of consciousness and later waking on respirator.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Self-perceived form: translucent white skin and an oversized robe; position changed when he thought about it. He reported possibly seeing the hospital scene 'through my eyelids.' He later reported developing out-of-body experiences over the next ten years.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “floating in blackness.” “The darkness had depth; it felt like the void went on to infinity.” “time seemed to come to a standstill.” “I wasn't breathing.”
